name: New dawn
author: Waltertheboss
description: Hold to the ceiling at 42% and touch the size portal while doing so. Navigate through the gameplay as the ship from 44%-45% where you can then hold to the ceiling. Drop down at 53%, get the gravity portal and then hold to the floor until 57% where you can navigate through the gameplay until 59% where you can touch the ship portal and play normally. Time a jump off the last stair at 70% and then don't click to fall to the floor right after touching the ship portal. Hold under the platform with the wave portal at 77% to get back into the level's gameplay (touching the ship portal at 80% is fine). Navigate through the gameplay until 82% where you have to go under the cube portal as the ship and can then hold to the ceiling right before the dash orb at 84%. Drop down at 88% and navigate through the gameplay until 95% where you can hold to the ceiling until the end.
